244	# Step 4: assertion evaluators
245	CALL_RELATION_TYPES = {"CALLS", "ASYNC_CALLS"}  # relation_set distinguishes calls - not approximated
246	
247	# Heuristic for "looks like a test": a test(s)/__tests__ path segment, or a
248	# filename ending in _test.<ext> - the only definition of "test" on offer.
249	TEST_PATH_PATTERN = re.compile(r"(^|/)(tests?|__tests__)(/|$)|_test\.[^/.]+$", re.IGNORECASE)
250	
251	def eval_symbol_exists(args, graph):
252	    """Never None - existence is always answerable."""
253	    return bool(find_symbols(graph, args.get("pattern", "")))
254	
255	def eval_has_inbound_edge(args, graph):
256	    """Any relation, of any type, from any source, landing on this symbol. False (not None) when the symbol doesn't exist: nonexistence definitively means no inbound edge."""
257	    ids = {s["id"] for s in _resolve_symbols(graph, args.get("symbol", ""))}
258	    return bool(ids) and any(edge.get("to_id") in ids for edge in all_edges(graph))
259	
260	def eval_calls(args, graph):
261	    caller_ids = [s["id"] for s in _resolve_symbols(graph, args.get("caller", ""))]
262	    callee_ids = {s["id"] for s in _resolve_symbols(graph, args.get("callee", ""))}
263	    if not caller_ids or not callee_ids:
264	        return False
265	    return any(
266	        edge.get("type") in CALL_RELATION_TYPES and edge.get("to_id") in callee_ids
267	        for cid in caller_ids
268	        for edge in graph["edges_by_source"].get(cid, [])
269	    )
270	
271	def eval_test_references(args, graph):
272	    ids = {s["id"] for s in _resolve_symbols(graph, args.get("symbol", ""))}
273	    if not ids:
274	        return False
275	    for edge in all_edges(graph):
276	        if edge.get("to_id") in ids:
277	            source = graph["by_id"].get(edge.get("from_id"))
278	            if source and TEST_PATH_PATTERN.search(source.get("file_path") or ""):
279	                return True
280	    return False
281	
282	def eval_literal_in_body(args, graph):
283	    """Regex search for `value` within the symbol's source range. Falls back to the whole file when the snapshot has no start_line/end_line - the evidence string names this as a widened window."""
284	    value = args.get("value", "")
285	    if not value:
286	        return None
287	    candidates = _resolve_symbols(graph, args.get("symbol", ""))
288	    if not candidates:
289	        return False
290	    repo = graph["repo"]
291	    for rec in candidates:
292	        path = rec.get("file_path")
293	        if not path:
294	            continue
295	        try:
296	            lines = open(os.path.join(repo, path), encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").readlines()
297	        except OSError:
298	            continue
299	        start, end = rec.get("start_line"), rec.get("end_line")
300	        snippet = "".join(lines[start - 1 : end]) if start and end else "".join(lines)
301	        if re.search(re.escape(value), snippet):
302	            return True
303	    return False
304	
305	# Per type: (evaluator, evidence-string builder, needles-for-drop-scan builder).
306	# One dict, one source of truth per assertion type - a sixth type adds a row
307	# here and nowhere else.
308	ASSERTION_HANDLERS = {
309	    "symbol_exists": (eval_symbol_exists, lambda a, ok: f"regex search for /{a.get('pattern')}/ in symbol names: {'match' if ok else 'no match'}", lambda a: [a.get("pattern")]),
310	    "has_inbound_edge": (eval_has_inbound_edge, lambda a, ok: f"inbound relations to '{a.get('symbol')}': {'found' if ok else 'not found'}", lambda a: [a.get("symbol")]),
311	    "calls": (eval_calls, lambda a, ok: f"CALLS/ASYNC_CALLS from '{a.get('caller')}' to '{a.get('callee')}': {'found' if ok else 'not found'}", lambda a: [a.get("caller"), a.get("callee")]),
312	    "test_references": (eval_test_references, lambda a, ok: f"inbound edge from a test-path file to '{a.get('symbol')}': {'found' if ok else 'not found'}", lambda a: [a.get("symbol")]),
313	    "literal_in_body": (eval_literal_in_body, lambda a, ok: f"regex search for {a.get('value')!r} in '{a.get('symbol')}' source: {'found' if ok else 'not found'}", lambda a: [a.get("value")]),
314	}
315	
316	def find_dropped_turn(turns, needles):
317	    """Scan Write/Edit tool_use payloads BACKWARDS for the requirement's
318	    symbol/literal; a hit becomes `dropped`, attributed to the last turn it
319	    appeared in - textual, so an unrelated turn reusing the same string can
320	    misattribute (the open risk noted in the design). None if it never
321	    appeared in a write or edit."""
322	    patterns = [_compile(n) for n in needles if n]
323	    if not patterns:
324	        return None
325	    for turn in reversed(turns):
326	        for tool_use in turn["tool_uses"]:
327	            if tool_use["name"] not in ("Write", "Edit"):
328	                continue
329	            inp = tool_use["input"]
330	            text = inp.get("content", "") + inp.get("old_string", "") + inp.get("new_string", "")
331	            if any(p.search(text) for p in patterns):
332	                return turn["index"]
333	    return None

336	def main():
337	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
338	    parser.add_argument("--repo", required=True)
339	    parser.add_argument("--checkpoint", required=True)
340	    parser.add_argument("--backend", choices=["local", "api"], default="local")

353	    prompt_text = "\n\n".join(t["text"] for t in turns if t["kind"] == "prompt")
354	    requirements = extract_requirements(prompt_text, backend=args.backend)
355	
356	    rows = []
357	    deferred = 0
358	    for req in requirements:
359	        args = req["assertion"].get("args", {})
360	        handler = ASSERTION_HANDLERS.get(req["assertion"]["type"])
361	        result = handler[0](args, graph) if handler else None
362	        if result is None:
